additional_info.subject: RE: 0417736 - ID0417736-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006] FC14 flashing red CRM:02023000571
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Based on our phone call, we would suggest checking the circuit after FC14 for any short circuits or component defects.
Validation FC14 is operating correctly is also required, to ensure the fault is not with the digital fuse itself.
With the electrical basics schematics provided during the training, the attached components can be examined.
As of now, we see the charger is online again and appears operational.
We look forward to hearing about the fault and repair process.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer

www.siemens.com.au/emobility
